Due to persistent signal interference, a direct flight corridor cannot be established between Station Alpha and Station Beta. Furthermore, due to overlapping communication frequencies, the inspection plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two flight paths: the corridor between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the corridor between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the most energy-efficient closed-loop inspection circuit, where each station is visited precisely once before the drone returns to its origin, thereby minimizing the total flight distance.
